about: Pelham is a town in Niagara Region, Ontario, in the short-hills and wine country between Welland, St. Catharines, and the Fonthill area. Rolling terrain, orchards, and the Fonthill Kame shape a quieter Niagara municipality away from the Falls strip. About 18,000 people live in Pelham.
seoSummary: Niagara Region town of Fonthill and short-hills wine country—orchards and rolling terrain, not the Falls corridor.
knownFor: Town centred on Fonthill in Niagara’s short hills
